description: This file defines the DataFieldRow class, a Drupal Views plugin that displays fields as raw data within a view row. It includes methods for initializing, defining options, building options forms, validating options, and rendering data fields with support for aliases and raw output options.

classes.name: DataFieldRow
classes.description: A Drupal Views plugin class that displays fields as raw data in a view row, supporting field aliasing and raw output options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up field options and raw output options based on provided view and display.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the plugin, including 'field_options'.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for field options, allowing users to set aliases and raw output preferences.

methods.name: validateAliasName
methods.description: Validates that alias names contain only allowed characters.

methods.name: validateOptionsForm
methods.description: Validates the options form, ensuring field aliases are unique.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the view row data, applying raw output or advanced rendering, and returns an array of field values.

methods.name: getFieldKeyAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias for a given field ID, or the ID itself if no alias is set.

methods.name: extractFromOptionsArray
methods.description: Extracts specific key values from an array of options.

search-terms: Drupal Views raw data field plugin
